gloss: dead branch; withered branch; dry twig

definitions.gloss: dead branch; withered branch; dry twig
definitions.explanation: A branch that has dried up and died on a tree, or one that has fallen from it. From {枯|か}れる (to wither) + {枝|えだ} (branch).

examples.japanese: {枯|か}れ{枝|えだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{拾|ひろ}う→拾う：00845_hirou⟧。

examples.english: A dead branch broke off in the wind.

examples.japanese: ⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{枯|か}れ{枝|えだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}って→切る：02693_kiru⟧⟦{束|たば}ねた→束ねる：13059_tabaneru⟧。
examples.english: I cut the dead branches in the garden and bundled them.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{枯|か}れる→枯れる：04589_kareru⟧ (to wither, to die of a plant) + ⟦{枝|えだ}→枝：02181_eda⟧ (branch).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{枯|か}れ{葉|は}→枯れ葉：20386_kareha⟧: dead, fallen leaves
- {枯|か}れ{木|き}: a dead tree
- ⟦{小枝|こえだ}→小枝：19403_koeda⟧: a twig (not necessarily dead)
